sources.supports: SciPy RK45 uses Dormand-Prince5(4), advances the fifth-order member, and uses a quartic dense polynomial.

RK45.P contains the seven-by-four exact rational literals adopted in this implementation. Retrieved display lines2041–2062 show every dense coefficient. The source attributes the extension to Shampine1986.
